title: Soil Conservation
claim: Reversing soil degradation through appropriate land management and conservation practices, including maintaining ground cover on exposed or degraded land, is identified by FAO as essential for preventing erosion and restoring degraded soils.
evidence_text: FAO's soil conservation guidance frames reversing soil degradation through appropriate land management as vital for food security, identifying soil conservation as involving erosion prevention, fertility maintenance, and restoration of degraded land through approaches such as conservation agriculture and integrated nutrient management. Documented regional techniques (compiled with partners such as WOCAT) commonly prioritise fast-establishing ground cover on slopes and bare patches most exposed to runoff.
